metadata.question: In 2004, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Death Valley, USA record the highest maximum daytime land surface temperature in the world?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (daily 1-km LST, daytime) - Year: 2004-01-01 → 2004-12-31 - Region of interest: Death Valley bounding box (US southwest) and a global land mask to exclude oceans 2. Masking: Use the QC_Day band to keep only pixels flagged as “good quality” (0 or 1) and mask water (MODIS land-water flag) 3. Logic: - Extract the annual maximum daytime LST for Death Valley - Extract the annual maximum daytime LST for all global land pixels - If the Death Valley value equals the global maximum → A (Yes), else B (No) - Handle missing tiles: if the 2004 MODIS collection has 0 images → C1 - After masking, if Death Valley has 0 valid pixels → C2 - If any computed maximum is None/NaN → C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize() # 1. Geometry & time death_val = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-117.3, 35.9, -116.2, 37.0]) # rough box over Death Valley year = 2004 start, end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1), ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31) # 2. Data acquisition lst = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')\ .filterDate(start, end)\ .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day', 'Land_Water_Mask']) if lst.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS images for 2004.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Quality & water mask def mask(img): qa = img.select('QC_Day') lwm = img.select('Land_Water_Mask') good = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1) # QC 00 or 01 = good land = lwm.eq(0) # 0 = land return img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)\ .updateMask(good.And(land)) lst_masked = lst.map(mask) # 4. Annual maxima dv_max = lst_masked.max().clip(death_val) glob_max = lst_masked.max() # Pixel counts dv_count = dv_max.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=death_val, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if dv_count == 0: print("Death Valley: 0 valid pixels.") print("C2") exit() # Values dv_val = dv_max.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.max(), geometry=death_val, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() glob_val = glob_max.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.max(), geometry=ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-180,-60],[180,-60],[180,85],[-180,85]]), scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if dv_val is None or glob_val is None: print("C3") exit() print(f"Death Valley 2004 max LST: {dv_val:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(dv_count)}") print(f"Global 2004 max LST: {glob_val:.2f} °C") print("A" if abs(dv_val - glob_val) < 0.01 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize()

# 1. Geometry & time
death_val = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-117.3, 35.9, -116.2, 37.0])  # rough box over Death Valley
year = 2004
start, end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1), ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31)

# 2. Data acquisition
lst = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')\
        .filterDate(start, end)\
        .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day', 'Land_Water_Mask'])
if lst.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No MODIS images for 2004.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Quality & water mask
def mask(img):
    qa = img.select('QC_Day')
    lwm = img.select('Land_Water_Mask')
    good = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1)  # QC 00 or 01 = good
    land = lwm.eq(0)                # 0 = land
    return img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)\
              .updateMask(good.And(land))
lst_masked = lst.map(mask)

# 4. Annual maxima
dv_max = lst_masked.max().clip(death_val)
glob_max = lst_masked.max()

# Pixel counts
dv_count = dv_max.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                               geometry=death_val, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)\
                 .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
if dv_count == 0:
    print("Death Valley: 0 valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# Values
dv_val = dv_max.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.max(),
                             geometry=death_val, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)\
               .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
glob_val = glob_max.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.max(),
                                 geometry=ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-180,-60],[180,-60],[180,85],[-180,85]]),
                                 scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9)\
                   .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

if dv_val is None or glob_val is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

print(f"Death Valley 2004 max LST: {dv_val:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(dv_count)}")
print(f"Global 2004 max LST: {glob_val:.2f} °C")

print("<answer>A</answer>" if abs(dv_val - glob_val) < 0.01 else "<answer>B</answer>")
